with deal_stages as (
    select
        deal_id,
        new_value::number as stage_id,
        change_timestamp
    from pipedrive_analytics.staging.stg_deal_changes
    where changed_field_key = 'stage_id'
    
    and change_timestamp > (select coalesce(max(valid_from), '2024-01-01'::timestamp) from pipedrive_analytics.intermediate.int_deal_stage_history)
     
),
stages as (
    select
        stage_id,
        initcap(stage_name) as stage_name
    from pipedrive_analytics.staging.stg_stages
)
select
    md5(cast(coalesce(cast(deal_id as TEXT), '_dbt_utils_surrogate_key_null_') || '-' || coalesce(cast(change_timestamp as TEXT), '_dbt_utils_surrogate_key_null_') as TEXT)) as deal_stage_change_id,
    deal_id,
    ds.stage_id,
    s.stage_name,
    change_timestamp as valid_from,
    lead(change_timestamp, 1) over (partition by deal_id order by change_timestamp) as valid_to
from deal_stages ds
left join stages s 
on ds.stage_id = s.stage_id

select deal_id
from pipedrive_analytics.intermediate.int_deal_stage_history
where deal_id is null

select stage_id
from pipedrive_analytics.intermediate.int_deal_stage_history
where stage_id is null

select valid_from
from pipedrive_analytics.intermediate.int_deal_stage_history
where valid_from is null

select deal_stage_change_id
from pipedrive_analytics.intermediate.int_deal_stage_history
where deal_stage_change_id is null

select
    deal_stage_change_id as unique_field,
    count(*) as n_records

from pipedrive_analytics.intermediate.int_deal_stage_history
where deal_stage_change_id is not null
group by deal_stage_change_id
having count(*) > 1

with child as (
    select stage_id as from_field
    from pipedrive_analytics.intermediate.int_deal_stage_history
    where stage_id is not null
),

parent as (
    select stage_id as to_field
    from pipedrive_analytics.staging.stg_stages
)

select
    from_field

from child
left join parent
    on child.from_field = parent.to_field

where parent.to_field is null

with child as (
    select deal_id as from_field
    from pipedrive_analytics.intermediate.int_deal_stage_history
    where deal_id is not null
),

parent as (
    select deal_id as to_field
    from pipedrive_analytics.staging.stg_deal_changes
)

select
    from_field

from child
left join parent
    on child.from_field = parent.to_field

where parent.to_field is null

with deal_stage_history as (
    select 
        deal_stage_change_id, 
        deal_id, 
        stage_id, 
        stage_name, 
        valid_from,
    from pipedrive_analytics.intermediate.int_deal_stage_history
    
        where valid_from > (select max(valid_from) from pipedrive_analytics.intermediate.int_deals_with_kpis)
        
),

activity_flags as (
    select
        a.deal_id,
        max(case when at.activity_name = 'Sales Call 1' and a.is_done then 1 else 0 end) as sales_call_1_done,
        max(case when at.activity_name = 'Sales Call 2' and a.is_done then 1 else 0 end) as sales_call_2_done
    from pipedrive_analytics.staging.stg_activity a
    join pipedrive_analytics.staging.stg_activity_types at
      on a.activity_type = at.activity_type_key
    where a.due_to_timestamp >= dateadd(day, -30, current_date)
    group by a.deal_id
),

deals_with_kpis as (
    select
        dsh.deal_stage_change_id,
        dsh.deal_id,
        dsh.stage_id,
        dsh.stage_name,
        dsh.valid_from,
        dsh.stage_name as funnel_step,
        case
            when dsh.stage_name = 'Qualified lead' and af.sales_call_1_done = 1 then 'Step 2.1: Sales Call 1'
            when dsh.stage_name = 'Needs Assessment' and af.sales_call_2_done = 1 then 'Step 3.1: Sales Call 2'
            else null
        end as funnel_sub_step
    from deal_stage_history dsh
    left join activity_flags af on dsh.deal_id = af.deal_id
)

select *
from deals_with_kpis

select deal_id
from pipedrive_analytics.intermediate.int_deals_with_kpis
where deal_id is null

select deal_stage_change_id
from pipedrive_analytics.intermediate.int_deals_with_kpis
where deal_stage_change_id is null

with all_values as (

    select
        funnel_sub_step as value_field,
        count(*) as n_records

    from pipedrive_analytics.intermediate.int_deals_with_kpis
    group by funnel_sub_step

)

select *
from all_values
where value_field not in (
    'Step 2.1: Sales Call 1','Step 3.1: Sales Call 2'
)

with child as (
    select deal_stage_change_id as from_field
    from pipedrive_analytics.intermediate.int_deals_with_kpis
    where deal_stage_change_id is not null
),

parent as (
    select deal_stage_change_id as to_field
    from pipedrive_analytics.intermediate.int_deal_stage_history
)

select
    from_field

from child
left join parent
    on child.from_field = parent.to_field

where parent.to_field is null

with deals_with_kpis as (
    select * from pipedrive_analytics.intermediate.int_deals_with_kpis 
),
unpivoted as (
    select
        deal_stage_change_id,
        date_trunc('month', valid_from)::date as month,
        funnel_step as kpi_name,
        funnel_step
    from deals_with_kpis
    where funnel_step is not null
    union all
    select
        deal_stage_change_id,
        date_trunc('month', valid_from)::date as month,
        funnel_sub_step as kpi_name,
        funnel_step
    from deals_with_kpis
    where funnel_sub_step is not null
),
final as (
    select
        month,
        kpi_name,
        funnel_step,
        count(distinct deal_stage_change_id) as deals_entered_stage_count
    from unpivoted
    group by 1, 2, 3
)
select * from final
order by month, funnel_step
